takeaways.severity: Critical CVEs reach KEV about 10× as often as Medium ones, yet only 1.2% of Critical CVEs ever do.
takeaways.weaknesses: OS Command Injection has the highest KEV rate of the common weakness types: 1.6% of its CVEs.
takeaways.coverage: In the 2025 backtest, our top 500 (scaled) caught 33% of exploited CVEs; exploit code + EPSS caught 27%.

takeaways.curves: Fixing the top 500 by our ranking catches 33% of the CVEs exploited later, against 27% for exploit code + EPSS.
takeaways.embedding: Descriptions of exploited CVEs (diamonds) sit close together: Granite's embedding places similar attacks near each other.

vendors.takeaway: Microsoft has the highest KEV rate of the largest vendors: 2.0% of its 17,847 CVEs were exploited.
